items.summary: ### Impact The writer option of the i18nTextCollectorTask dev task was passed to the injector without validation. A crafted dev task URL could create arbitrary objects with attacker-controlled constructor arguments and run code on the server. items.title: mail-parser: Path Traversal vulnerability in attachment extraction
